content: {"reasoning":"The claim was denied CO-197 (prior auth missing at time of service). This payer offers no retroactive authorization window and no peer-to-peer review, and a medical-necessity appeal has already been filed with no further recourse. Missing prior auth is the provider's administrative failure, so the balance cannot be billed to the patient, and resubmitting would only draw a CO-18 duplicate denial. No available action can progress collection, so the balance is uncollectible.","action":"write_off"}
